summary.text: Hanu Karlapalem is the Democratic candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Parker Moore.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Karlapalem described himself as a small technology business owner who has lived in Madison, Alabama, for 26 years.

paragraphs.text: Karlapalem said in a Ballotpedia survey that he holds a master's degree in Management Information Systems from the University of Alabama in Huntsville and is a former board member of the UAH Alumni Association.
He also said he is a life member and former second vice president of the NAACP Limestone County Unit.
Karlapalem was unopposed for the Democratic nomination, as the District 4 primary scheduled for May 19, 2026, was canceled.

His campaign theme, as he listed it in the survey, is "An Alabama We Can Afford," covering lower costs, stronger public schools and healthcare, and he called for a moratorium on new data center development along with community benefit agreements and environmental review.
He listed the Alabama AFL-CIO, 314 Action Fund, Everytown for Gun Safety Action Fund and the Alabama Democratic County Chairs' Association as endorsers.
